Step 1 — Connect accounts
Open Connected accounts. Paste access token + Page / IG Business user ID (encrypted vault). Click Test connection (live API) — Facebook/Instagram hit Meta Graph; TikTok hits creator_info. Register apps in Integrations hub first.
Step 2 — Pick content from the pack
Marketing pack ships 16 modern captions (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X) plus TikTok reel scripts. Tenant CP auto-adapts brand name, domain, and hashtags for Acme Parts.
Step 3 — Publish from Drafts (with video)
Open Drafts → Compose. Choose Facebook / Instagram / TikTok, paste a public HTTPS image or .mp4 URL (or click Use as media URL on a sample reel), then Publish now. Instagram: media → poll → media_publish. TikTok: PULL_FROM_URL (verify domain). Unaudited TikTok apps: SELF_ONLY only.
Step 4 — AI advisor
Check weekly formats and industry hooks, then generate a caption for your product line. GCC: mix English + Arabic hashtags. Pakistan: Urdu/English on Facebook; English on LinkedIn.
Step 5 — Measure & handoff
Published drafts store external post IDs. Track clicks via Web tracker / GA4. LinkedIn and X remain copy→native until those APIs are wired — vault still keeps tokens safe for your team.
GCC & Pakistan best practices
  • UAE/GCC: Post Sun–Thu 10am–1pm GST; compliance + trade-pricing posts build B2B trust.
  • Pakistan: Facebook + WhatsApp Status repurposing; Urdu captions for retail; English for B2B LinkedIn.
  • All markets: Never post raw credentials; use the CP vault only. Enable 2FA on every social account.
  • Video: Start from sample reels under TikTok, replace with your screen recording, host on public HTTPS, then Publish.
